title: Personal Loan Grade Relief on Graduated-Return Lines
content:
> For a graduated-return line on a Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a loan in Personal Loan Grade E, F or G takes 4 points off the share of the step up charged; a loan in Personal Loan Grade C or D takes 2 points off it; a loan in Personal Loan Grade A or B takes none. The grade is the rate grade on the loan's Personal Loans record.

| Personal Loans grade | Points off the share |
|---|---|
| Personal Loan Grade E, F or G | 4 |
| Personal Loan Grade C or D | 2 |
| Personal Loan Grade A or B | none |

The seven grades are the whole range of Personal Loans grades, so every loan falls on exactly one row.
